question: Estimate the number of elevators in Mumbai.
idealClarificationQuestions: Working passenger elevators in residential + commercial buildings? Yes — operational only.
Greater Mumbai (~22M) or just BMC area (~13M)? Greater Mumbai including Thane and Navi Mumbai.
Hospitals + malls + offices + residential all combined? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Segment by building type → buildings of each type → elevators per building.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Greater Mumbai households: ~5.5M; ~70% in apartments (rest in chawls / standalone) = ~3.85M apartment HH.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~5.5M; ~70% in apartments (rest in chawls / standalone) = ~3.85M apartment HH.
~5,000 buildings (estimate based on commercial floor space ~150M sqft and avg 30K sqft per building); avg 6 elevators each = 30K elevators.

calculationFlow: Greater Mumbai households: ~5.5M; ~70% in apartments (rest in chawls / standalone) = ~3.85M apartment HH.
Average apartment building has ~30 flats and ~2 elevators (G+7 to G+30 mix).
Number of residential apartment buildings: 3.85M / 30 = ~128K buildings.
Commercial offices in Mumbai: ~5,000 buildings (estimate based on commercial floor space ~150M sqft and avg 30K sqft per building); avg 6 elevators each = 30K elevators.
Malls + multiplexes: ~150 large + 500 mid; avg 5 each = ~3K.
